summary.plain: The upgraded version of the MEG detector: a finer liquid-xenon calorimeter and new tracking and timing detectors, at the same Swiss laboratory, still taking data.
summary.technical: Upgrade of the MEG detector: higher-granularity LXe calorimeter, single-volume cylindrical drift chamber (replacing MEG's drift chamber array), upgraded plastic-scintillator timing counter and a new radiative decay counter (RDC) for normalization, on the PSI piE5 beamline. First physics run 2021, ongoing data-taking through at least 2023 per the most recent fetched source. No separately sourced subsystem dimension quantities were fetched this session.

technology.quote: Liquid Xenon Calorimeter...Cylindrical Drift Chamber...Timing Counter...Target and Radial Drift Chamber (RDC)
technology.value: Upgraded liquid xenon calorimeter with finer granularity, a new single-volume cylindrical drift chamber, upgraded timing counter and a new radiative decay counter, on the same PSI DC muon beamline
